node.statement: The three Stage-1 producer applications in the same fresh corner. The space A_fresh=S_{P_fresh} is finite-dimensional, is an extended epsilon_X-C*-algebra for epsilon_X:=L*epsilon, and has 1<dim_C A_fresh<infinity by the hypothesis on S_{P_j}. The threshold ledger gives epsilon_X<=e_proj,e_np,e_pair. Hence lem-stage1-rectified-nontrivial-projection supplies its nontrivial C_proj*epsilon_X-projection, lem-stage1-original-complementary-pair supplies its nonvanishing complementary C_np*epsilon_X-projections for the original corner product and unit, and lem-stage1-fresh-two-point-inclusion supplies nonvanishing complementary projections P_prime,P_dprime and the explicit map v_fresh:C^2->A_fresh, v_fresh(lambda,mu)=lambda*P_prime+mu*P_dprime, as an extended C_pair*epsilon_X-inclusion with its unit clause and fixed amplification family. The three producer bounds are at most t_1 by the definition of K_1.
